messages.subject: error installing aroma.affymetrix

to the instructions on the page.

webpage.
Has this something to do with the R release (R2.5.0) ?

Regards

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] error installing aroma.affymetrix
parts:
aroma.affymetrix requires the latest release version of R, which is
now R v2.6.x and which will very soon be R v2.7.0. Your R version is
outdated.

-Henrik
